adds.title: Rectification of the Laws (Penal Code) Order, 2026 under Revision of the Laws Act
adds.summary: On 26 March 2026 Botswana formally deleted paragraphs (a) and (c) of Penal Code Section 164 on Unnatural Offences which criminalized having carnal knowledge of any person against the order of nature or permitting such carnal knowledge with penalties of up to seven years' imprisonment, leaving only carnal knowledge of an animal as an unnatural offence, thereby implementing the 2019 High Court ruling upheld by the Court of Appeal in 2021 that criminalizing consensual same-sex sexual activity violates constitutional rights to dignity, liberty, privacy and equality.

adds.title: Botswana High Court December 2017 - Ricki Kgositau ruling
adds.summary: In December 2017 the Botswana High Court ordered the government to legally recognise Tshepo Ricki Kgositau as female and issue a new identity card marking her as female before the end of 2017 after a nearly four-year case following her December 2016 gender confirmation surgery, where being marked male on official documents caused emotional distress and vulnerability to abuse and violence; in November 2017 the court had similarly ordered recognition and new identity documents before year-end for a transgender man identified as ND after the appeal was dropped.
